			<!-- 
  COLLE CE CODE dans WPCode → Nouveau Snippet → HTML/JS
  Ou dans Elementor → HTML widget sur chaque page
  
  Ce script gère l'affichage/masquage des formulaires au clic des boutons.
  Les boutons Elementor doivent avoir comme lien : #ms-resa-surf (ou autre ID)
-->
<script>
(function(){
  function showForm(id){
    var el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el)return;
    el.style.display='block';
    setTimeout(function(){el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});},80);
  }
  function hideForm(id){
    var el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(el)el.style.display='none';
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    // Clic sur lien ancre #ms-resa-xxx
    var a=e.target.closest('a[href^="#ms-resa-"]');
    if(a){
      e.preventDefault();
      showForm(a.getAttribute('href').substring(1));
      return;
    }
    // Clic sur bouton fermer
    var cls=e.target.closest('.msw-close-btn');
    if(cls){
      e.preventDefault();
      hideForm(cls.getAttribute('data-close'));
      return;
    }
  });
})();

<script>
function setAll(wind,wave,temp,surf,kite){
  ['','2'].forEach(s=>{
    document.getElementById('mg-wind'+s).textContent=wind;
    document.getElementById('mg-wave'+s).textContent=wave;
    document.getElementById('mg-temp'+s).textContent=temp;
    document.getElementById('mg-surf'+s).textContent=surf;
    document.getElementById('mg-kite'+s).textContent=kite;
  });
}
function windDir(d){return['N','NNE','NE','ENE','E','ESE','SE','SSE','S','SSO','SO','OSO','O','ONO','NO','NNO'][Math.round(d/22.5)%16]}
function conditions(w,h){
  return{
    surf:h<0.5?'Calme':h<1.2?'Bonnes':h<2?'Idéales':'Puissantes',
    kite:w<15?'Léger':w<25?'Bonnes':w<35?'Idéales':'Fort'
  }
}
async function load(){
  try{
    const [w,m]=await Promise.all([
      fetch('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=31.5085&longitude=-9.7595&current=temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m&wind_speed_unit=kmh&timezone=Africa%2FCasablanca').then(r=>r.json()),
      fetch('https://marine-api.open-meteo.com/v1/marine?latitude=31.5085&longitude=-9.7595&current=wave_height,wave_period&timezone=Africa%2FCasablanca').then(r=>r.json())
    ]);
    const wind=Math.round(w.current.wind_speed_10m);
    const dir=windDir(w.current.wind_direction_10m);
    const temp=Math.round(w.current.temperature_2m);
    const wave=m.current.wave_height.toFixed(1);
    const period=Math.round(m.current.wave_period);
    const c=conditions(wind,parseFloat(wave));
    setAll(`${wind} km/h ${dir}`,`${wave}m — Période ${period}s`,`${temp}°C`,c.surf,c.kite);
  }catch(e){
    setAll('Alizé du Nord','1.2m','22°C','Bonnes','Idéales');
  }
}
load();
setInterval(load,1800000);
</script>				</div>

					<p class="e-51896bb-f3d5bea e-paragraph-base e-default-p" data-interaction-id="51896bb">DISCIPLINE 01</p>

function buildMonths(){

  if(s.act==='yoga'){

function buildDates(){

  var sub=money(p)+' × '+who+' · ';
  if(r==='reg'){sub+=T.lbl_regular}
  else{sub+=(r==='lm'?T.lbl_last_minute:T.lbl_special)+' ('+T.instead+' <s>'+money(REF[s.act])+'</s>)'}
  if(s.n>=2)sub+=T.disc;
  g('bk-psub').innerHTML=sub;
}
function actLabel(){return s.act==='surf'?T.surf_lbl:(s.act==='kite'?T.kite_lbl:T.yoga_lbl)}
function range(){
  if(s.date==='custom')return {a:g('bk-date-from').value,b:g('bk-date-to').value};
  var m=monthObj(s.month),d=null;
  m.dates.forEach(function(x){if(x.s===s.date)d=x});
  return {a:d.s,b:d.e};
}
function dlabel(){var r=range();return T.from_+' '+fmtd(r.a)+' '+T.to+' '+fmtd(r.b)}
function total(){var r=rateFor(startIso()),p=(r==='reg')?REG[s.act]:SPECIAL[s.act];return p*s.n}
window.bkNext=function(){
  if(!s.act){warn(T.w_act);return}
  if(!s.date){warn(T.w_date);return}
  if(s.date==='custom'){
    var f=g('bk-date-from').value,t=g('bk-date-to').value;
    if(!f||!t){warn(T.w_custom);return}
    if(nightsBetween(f,t)<1){warn(T.w_order);return}
  }
  var r=range(),n=nightsBetween(r.a,r.b);
  var line='<strong>'+(s.act==='surf'?'🏄 ':'🪁 ')+actLabel()+'</strong><br>'+dlabel()+' ('+n+' '+(n>1?T.nights:T.night)+') · '+s.n+' '+(s.n>1?T.peopleN:T.people1);
  line+=(s.act==='yoga')?' · '+T.price_req:' · '+money(total());
  g('bk-sum').innerHTML=line;
  g('bk-s1').classList.remove('on');g('bk-s2').classList.add('on');
  window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];window.dataLayer.push({'event':'booking_step1_complete','activity':s.act});
  var el=g('reservation');if(el&&el.scrollIntoView)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
};
window.bkBack=function(){g('bk-s2').classList.remove('on');g('bk-s1').classList.add('on')};
window.bkSubmit=function(){
  var w=g('bk-warn2');w.textContent='';
  var fn=g('bk-fn'),em=g('bk-email'),ok=true;
  fn.classList.remove('err');em.classList.remove('err');
  if(!fn.value.trim()){fn.classList.add('err');w.textContent=T.w_fn;ok=false}
  if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(em.value.trim())){em.classList.add('err');if(ok)w.textContent=T.w_mail;ok=false}
  if(!ok)return;
  var yoga=(s.act==='yoga');
  var btn=g('bk-btn2');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent=T.sending;
  var r=range(),fd=new FormData();
  fd.append('access_key','96153601-0afd-4374-b2a3-5ed98edde355');
  fd.append('subject',yoga?T.subj_yoga:(T.subj+actLabel()+' · Mogasurf'));
  fd.append('from_name','Mogasurf Website');
  fd.append('cc','info@mogasurf.com,bentalhameriiem@gmail.com,ismail.adarzane@gmail.com');
  fd.append('botcheck','');
  fd.append('Language',T.lang);
  fd.append('Activity',yoga?'Kitesurf + Yoga (info request)':actLabel());
  fd.append('Arrival',r.a);
  fd.append('Departure',r.b);
  fd.append('Stay dates',dlabel());
  fd.append('People',s.n);
  if(yoga){fd.append('Price','On request (no price shown)')}
  else{fd.append('Estimated total',total()+'€');fd.append('Rate',T.ratef[rateFor(startIso())])}
  fd.append('First name',fn.value.trim());
  fd.append('Last name',g('bk-ln').value.trim());
  fd.append('Email',em.value.trim());
  if(g('bk-phone').value.trim())fd.append('Phone',g('bk-cc').value+' '+g('bk-phone').value.trim());
  if(g('bk-msg').value.trim())fd.append('Message',g('bk-msg').value.trim());
  fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit',{method:'POST',body:fd})
  .then(function(x){return x.json()})
  .then(function(d){
    if(d.success){
      g('bk-fields').style.display='none';g('bk-ok').classList.add('show');
      if(typeof fbq==='function')fbq('track','Lead');
      window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];window.dataLayer.push({'event':'camp_booking_success','form_type':yoga?'yoga_info':'site_booking'});
    }else{alert(T.err)}
    btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent=yoga?T.confirm_yoga:T.confirm;
  })
  .catch(function(){alert(T.net);btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent=yoga?T.confirm_yoga:T.confirm});
};
buildMonths();buildDates();
})();
</script>				</div>

        <script type='text/javascript'>
        (function () {
            function runPixelCode( response ) {
                if ( ! response || ! response.data || ! response.data.fb_pxl_code ) {
                    return;
                }

                try {
                    new Function( response.data.fb_pxl_code )();
                } catch ( e ) {
                    console && console.warn
                        && console.warn( 'Meta Pixel response parsing failed. Please check if your pixel is connected.', e );
                }
            }

            var radio = window.nfRadio
                || ( window.Backbone && window.Backbone.Radio );
            if ( radio && radio.channel ) {
                radio.channel( 'forms' ).on( 'submit:response', runPixelCode );
            }

            if ( window.jQuery ) {
                window.jQuery( document ).on(
                    'nfFormSubmitResponse',
                    function ( event, data ) {
                        if ( data && data.response ) {
                            runPixelCode( data.response );
                        }
                    }
                );
            }
        })();
        </script>

                    } catch ( e ) {
                        console && console.warn && console.warn( 'Meta Pixel eval failed', e );
                    }
                }
            } );
        })( window.jQuery );

					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];

function mogaNlSend(){
  var em = document.getElementById("moga-nl-email").value.trim();
  if(!em || em.indexOf("@") < 0){ document.getElementById("moga-nl-email").style.border="2px solid #1c3522"; return; }

  fd.append("access_key","96153601-0afd-4374-b2a3-5ed98edde355");

  fd.append("from_name","Mogasurf Newsletter");
  fd.append("Email",em);
  fd.append("botcheck","");

  .then(function(r){return r.json();})
  .then(function(){
    document.getElementById("moga-nl-form").style.display="none";

  });
}
